text: A prompt or response can carry personal data, and most teams don't decide that on purpose. Direct user input, retrieved context, conversation history, even the model's own output.
Direct identifiers have a recognizable shape — email, phone, SSN — catchable with pattern matching. Quasi-identifiers don't look like PII alone but can identify someone in combination.
A real first layer: a redact function that pattern-matches common direct identifiers, run before a prompt is logged, sent to a provider, or included in an eval dataset.
Regex catches an email address because it has a fixed shape. It does not catch a name and a location with no fixed pattern. Production handling layers named entity recognition on top.
Pattern-based redaction catches the obvious cases and misses the rest. Next up: compliance — the regulatory landscape this is actually in service of.
